Blighted Barman is an undead zombie in Reithwin Town in Act Two.
“
Haul yourself up chum, and let the old whiskey jug b-b-bite you. So what'll it be?
„
— Blighted Barman

Involvement

Act Two

Blighted Barman can be found alongside  Thisobald Thorm in The Waning Moon. He goes through the motions of taking drink requests, but his words are out of order.
